folder: What Happens When You Ignore Her Teeth - Pencil Sketch

shots.vo_line: This is what would happen to a cat whose owner ignores her teeth.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat takes two slow, heavy steps forward across the rug, head low, mouth slightly open, tail swaying gently. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: After the first month, plaque starts creeping under the gumline, where it should never be.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the open mouth trembles slightly as the plaque-coated teeth glisten and the red gums pulse faintly, the jaw holding still. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: She gets the dental
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat gently lowers her raised paw to the floor and sniffs the biscuits, nose dipping slowly, whiskers twitching. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: biscuits. They crumble
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat bites down slowly and the biscuit cracks between her teeth, a few small crumbs falling, her head staying steady. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: before they
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat chews slowly as the biscuit crumbles in her mouth, dry crumbs drifting down to the floor, her body staying still. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: do anything.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat stays seated and looks down at the crumbs, unimpressed, slowly licking her lips once, her tail resting still. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: She gets the water additive. It smells wrong to a nose
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat keeps her head turned away from the water bowl, nose wrinkling and whiskers twitching in disdain, tail swaying slowly. The bottle stays still. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: 40 times more sensitive than yours.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat holds her pose beside the water bowl, ears flicking, nose twitching as she sniffs the air, head turning slightly further away. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: So she goes back to chewing the charger cable. It's the only thing that soothes her gums.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat chews slowly on the charger cable, jaw working side to side, ears twitching, her crouched body staying low and still. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: Her owner moves the water bowl closer.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the woman's hand slowly slides the water bowl forward across the floorboards as she smiles; the cat sits still behind, ears twitching. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: She sniffs it once and walks
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat lowers her nose slowly toward the water, sniffs once just above the surface, then lifts her head slightly back; the water ripples faintly. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: away.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat takes two slow steps away from the water bowl, tail held high and swaying gently, staying inside the frame. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: After two months, her breath starts catching you when she yawns,
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat finishes a slow, wide yawn while the woman leans her head back, eyes squeezed shut, nose wrinkling, one hand raised. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: on the pillow when she sleeps.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat breathes slowly in her sleep on the pillow while the woman slowly turns her face further away, nose wrinkling; the lamp glows softly. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: Her owner notices, but tells herself that's just how cats are.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the woman gives a small shrug with a half-smile, hands lifting slightly then settling; the cat sits beside her, blinking slowly. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: The chewing gets worse.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat gnaws hard on the frayed cable, jaw working and head tugging slightly, paws holding the cable, body staying on the sofa. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: Her owner buys another charger. Nothing changes.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the woman sighs, shoulders rising and dropping, and glances down at the new charger in her hand; the cat watches from the sofa, ears flicking. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: After three months, the plaque has hardened into tartar.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the open mouth holds still with a slight jaw tremble, the crusted tartar and red gums glistening faintly. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: Every single bite pushes it into gums that were never meant to take it.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat chews slowly at the bowl, wincing with eyes squeezed shut, jaw moving stiffly, head staying low over the bowl. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: The discomfort never fully stops.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat stays hunched on the rug, breathing slowly, eyes half closed, ears drooping a little lower, a faint tremble in her jaw. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: She starts pulling her head away every time her owner tries to touch her face.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the woman's hand reaches gently toward the cat's cheek and the cat pulls her head back, ears flattening, staying seated on the rug. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: Her owner calls it attitude.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat holds her arched back and hisses, fur bristling, all four feet planted on the rug; the woman leans back slightly with her hands raised. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: It's not attitude.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat hisses, ears pinned back, mouth opening slightly wider, whiskers quivering, her head steady in the frame. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: It's pain. And she's dealing with it alone, every single day.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat lies still with her chin on her paws, breathing slowly, eyes blinking heavily, one ear twitching. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: By month four, she's started pawing and rubbing at her own mouth.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat paws slowly at her mouth with one front paw, face screwed up, then lowers the paw, staying seated on the rug. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: Her owner thinks it's grooming. It's not grooming.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat licks her paw and rubs it slowly over her mouth; in the background, the woman keeps reading on the sofa and turns a page. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: It's her body desperately trying to fix what nothing in that home is fixing for her.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat rubs her cheek slowly along the table leg, eyes shut tight, body pressing against it, tail swaying gently. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: This doesn't have to happen.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat sits calmly and looks up hopefully, blinking slowly, ears perking, tail curling at her side; the sunbeam shimmers softly. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: Her saliva already reaches every tooth,
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: glistening saliva flows slowly over every tooth, catching the light, while the open mouth holds still with a faint jaw tremble. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: every gap and every gumline, all day and all night.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: glistening saliva runs slowly into the gaps between the teeth and along the gumline, the jaw holding still. Slow pan right.

shots.vo_line: No brush has ever done that.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat walks slowly away into the background, tail up and swaying, staying in view, while the toothbrush lies still on the floorboards. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: The moment Meow Mouth goes on her dinner, she eats it,
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the woman tips the scoop and pale powder sprinkles gently onto the food while the cat leans in, sniffing. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: and her own saliva carries the zinc and plant enzymes to the plaque.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: glistening saliva washes slowly over the teeth and the plaque crumbles into tiny flakes that drift away. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: Every single meal
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat eats slowly from the bowl, head dipping gently, ears twitching, tail swaying. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: does what it's
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat keeps eating contentedly, jaw moving gently, eyes half closed, tail curling slowly. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: supposed to do.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat licks the bowl slowly with her tongue, eyes closed in bliss, head moving gently, paws staying still. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: And because it's made with brewer's yeast and a bacon flavour,
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat sniffs the food with half-closed, blissful eyes, nose twitching and whiskers quivering, head dipping slightly. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: she clears her bowl every time she comes back.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat licks the bowl clean with slow strokes of her tongue, head moving gently, tail curling happily. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: After a week, her breath is softer.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat finishes a slow yawn close to the woman's face and she smiles warmly, leaning in, not pulling away. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: After a month, she lets her owner kiss her goodnight again.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the woman holds a gentle kiss on top of the cat's head, eyes closed; the cat breathes slowly, purring, as the lamp glows softly. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: That's why she keeps coming back to her bowl every single day,
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat takes two slow, light steps toward the bowl, tail held high and swaying, stopping at the bowl. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: cleaning her teeth with every meal, with no brush and no fight.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat holds a big contented smile, blinking slowly, whiskers twitching, head tilting slightly. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: That's Meow Mouth.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: soft sunlight shimmers gently across the floorboards while the bowl stays still. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: And right now, it's buy two,
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat sits calmly, blinking slowly and turning her head slightly, tail curling at her side. The tubs stay completely still with their labels facing the camera, lids closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: get one free.
shots.motion_prompt: Hand-drawn pencil sketch animation: the cat sleeps curled up, breathing slowly, one ear twitching once. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Slow camera push-in.
